title: Diamonds
intro: Diamonds are the premium currency of Zoo 2 and can be earned through game play and giveaways or purchased for real money. Various animals, decorations, land expansions, breeding slots, chest keys, region unlocks, and certain buildings require diamonds. This currency is much harder to get than coins, but there are several ways to earn free diamonds and a few ways to buy them with real money in a savvy way.
earning_body: Diamonds can be earned through regular gameplay, awarded through Upjers social media followings or giveaways, by watching advertisements (on certain platforms only), and various other methods. Sources include: level-up rewards, Conservation Week events, daily login rewards, the Season Pass, shell games, quest rewards, billboard video ads (up to 2 per day), promo codes from newsletters and social media, the Upjers Portal, and the Telegram/Discord Uppy Bot.
spending_body: The best time to spend diamonds is during a Cashback event. Maximize the diamonds you get back by spending 2,000 or more diamonds during the event. The biggest sales tend to be in mid-Spring (around May) and mid-Fall (end of November). Almost everything purchasable with diamonds goes on sale at some point with the exception of breeding slots, chest keys, admissions booth upgrades, and Zoo Academy subscriptions.
deals_body: Diamonds can be purchased for real money. Diamond packages of 100+ diamonds usually include at least one exclusive bonus animal with its enclosure. The price of diamond packages depends on the player's platform and country as well as the current promotion.
deal_special_guest_body: A standing offer of one exclusive Special Guest NPC is available to players for any real money purchase. Limit one per promotion. Promotions last about a year before rotating to a new NPC. Earned diamonds from video ads, gameplay, subscriptions, and giveaways do not count.
deal_piggy_bank_body: A limited-time deal available to players who have never purchased the Piggy Bank offer. Spend 5,000 coins in the game to fill the piggy bank and purchase 100 diamonds at about 60% off. Bonus animal not included. Limit one per account.
deal_welcome_body: Players that have never purchased diamonds before can receive 100–120% bonus diamonds for the 50, 100, or 200 diamond packs in the browser. Special Guest bonus included. This deal comes once a year and is usually only available for one week.
deal_fun_fiesta_body: Up to 400% off — gives 50 diamonds for the price of 10 diamonds. Bonus animal not included. Limit one per promotion offer. This deal comes about twice a year and is only available for one week. Recommended to buy only the small pack with this deal.
deal_bunny_bite_body: Save up to $50 — Diamond packages are offered without excess bonus diamonds, resulting in a lower overall price. Ideal for players who want bonus animals without spending as much. Comes about twice a year, available for one week.
deal_voucher_body: Code for 300 premium currency — Offered exclusively in the browser version. Diamond packages give half the bonus diamonds to you and the other half inside a redemption code you can share with a friend or use yourself. Redeeming vouchers of 100 diamonds or more gives a bonus animal and its enclosure. Comes once or twice a year.
deal_star_savings_body: Up to 101% more — The best deal in price-per-diamond. For about the same price as the normal 1,000+ diamond package, you can buy 2,010 diamonds dispersed as 67 diamonds per day for 30 days. Limit one of each package per promotion. Comes once or twice a year, available for one week.
deal_55_body: A frequent deal with various promo names, such as Spring Bonus, Midsommar, Buzzing Bonus, Autumn Bonus, and Shimmering Skies.
deal_60_body: A frequent deal with various promo names, such as Summer Bonus, Happy Hearts, and Winter Bonus. The browser-only Loyalty Package is also this same deal for 200, 500, and 1,000 packs.
buying_body: Players can purchase diamonds in bundles of 10, 30, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1,000, and 2,500. When buying 100 diamonds or more, bundles often come with bonus diamonds and/or bonus animals. Standard pricing varies by platform and country. Steam, Epic, Apple App Store, and Google Play prices may differ from web browser prices.
